verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Entra ID's source being published under an open license, and a community post describes it as a closed-source cloud service. The public GitHub docs repo and the Graph metadata/OpenAPI descriptions are documentation and API descriptions, not product source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
